title: Who does the addition?
hook: An AI writes the request add(7,5). Which part of the pipeline actually does the sum?

doesNotKnow: the difference between a tool request and its execution

misconception: The model or request text itself performs the calculation.
objective: Identify the boundary between a scripted tool request and the code executing it.

claims.text: The scripted request add(7,5) produces 12 only when the executor runs; the numbers-only executor returns Type error for add(7,"pear"). Request, executor and result are displayed as distinct records. Trying pear changes the current request to add(7,"pear") and displays its associated Type error; the retained add(7,5) → 12 witness remains.

claims.text: The request describes an operation and is distinct from its execution; this is a scripted fixture, not a live model.
